title: Exposure Steward & Rapid-Rewind Protocol (working notes)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working sketch for a cross-functional approach to exposure governance that centers a human steward and a fast, low-friction rollback pathway (the "rapid-rewind"). Goal is to reduce blast radius for multi-model and latency-sensitive LLM features while keeping cycles short for product teams.

Audience:
- Release stewards and product owners
- Oncall and SREs covering rollout windows
- Solutions & PS engineers running customer pilots
- Data/measurement partners monitoring quality regression

Context and motivation:
- We run many progressive exposures across hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Incidents often happen when subtle semantic regressions or sample-specific hallucinations slip past automated checks.
- Current canary choreography is too slow to revert semantic regressions because teams need manual signoff and patch PRs. 
- We want a standardized ceremony + an automated, low-latency fallback that any steward can trigger within the "rewind window" (first 60–120 minutes after activation).

Core concepts (new-ish):
- Steward Beacon: a single Slack + Pager duty flow owned for an activation. Owner is responsible for signal triage and first-level revert.
- Rewind Window: a configurable short duration after cohort activation where rollback is instantaneous via routing policy flip with pre-warmed fallback.
- Entropy Budget: a numeric score representing expected sample variability for the slice; high entropy slices require extra human review before expansion.
- Canary Cells: tiny cohorts (0.1–0.5%) instrumented with synthetic probes and user-probing telemetry. Cells rotate ownership among stewards to avoid stale views.

Ceremony & cadence (ops script):
1) Pre-activation (Day -3 to 0)
   - Draft hypothesis and key metrics (latency budget, top-5 intent precision, safety hits per 1000 requests).
   - Run offline eval suite for 2k holdout prompts (regression delta thresholds set).
   - Confirm rollback artifact exists: routing policy id + fallback model id + QA smoke test PR.
   - Create Steward Beacon: add PD rotation, Slack notify channel, fill activation doc.
2) Activation (T0)
   - Start with Canary Cell A (0.1%). Trigger synthetic probe waveform (15m cadence).
   - Telemetry: stream percentile latency, error rate, semantic quality probes (BLEU-style, retrieval F1 if applicable), safety classifier hits.
   - Steward triages every 15 minutes inside rewind window.
3) Rapid-Rewind (T0 -> T0+rewind-window)
   - If any hard threshold crossed (safety hits > X/1000, latency p99 > SLO + 30%), steward triggers routing flip to fallback via console shortcut.
   - Post-rewind: automated snapshotting of traces, token logs, customer-visible examples (redacted).
4) Stabilization (after rewind-window)
   - If stable for N cycles, expand to sequential cells (0.5% -> 2% -> 10%). Each expansion gated by automated acceptance tests.

Measurement plan (signals):
- Safety signals: number of classifier-positive outputs per 10k requests; near-match ratio to known policy violations. Threshold examples: >5/10k triggers immediate rewind.
- Quality signals: holdout prompt delta (mean token-level loss change), user-reported negative actions, NLU intent confusion matrix shift.
- Latency & errors: p50/p95/p99 latency; RPC error delta; token-generation variance.
- Business signals: retention/ctr delta, revenue-affecting flows.
- Synthetic probes: seeded prompts covering top 50 intents; probes report per-probe deltas; if >3 probes fail consecutively -> review.

Rewind checklist (runbook for steward):
- Confirm alert meets pre-specified metric breach (copy-paste metric and time window).
- Run the smoke CLI: ./rollout rewind --policy-id <id> --fallback <model-id> --reason "<note>".
- Post a short incident note in steward channel with links to traces and 3 redacted examples.
- If rollback was customer-visible, escalate to CS for customer outreach template.
- Annotate experiment with root-cause hypothesis and link to linear ticket.

Fallback orchestration details (ops notes):
- Pre-bake fallback model: must be compatible (tokenizer + input schema), pre-warmed routes provisioned.
- Routing flip implementation: atomic config toggle in routing layer which supports quick rollback without infra changes.
- Circuit breaker: if underlying infra capacity < 2x request rate, do not expand; instead throttle.

Communication templates (short):
- Slack alert (steward): "ACTIVATION ALERT: experiment <name> breached safety threshold at T+18m. Rewinding to <fallback>. See <link> for traces. Owner: <name>."
- Customer note (CS): brief apology + explanation + expected follow-up time.

AB vs Canary decisions (heuristics):
- Use Canary (gradual expansion) for risk of semantic drift or unknown behavior with small population exposure.
- Use A/B when evaluating product metrics with statistically robust sample (clear KPI and longer horizon).
- If the feature touches billing or critical flows -> require A/B with pre-approved experimental contract.

Operational training (run-throughs):
- Monthly tabletop sessions with: steward, SRE, CS, product analyst. Playbook includes 1 simulated rewind per session.
- Steward shadowing rotation: new stewards shadow three activations before being primary.

Open questions / things to decide: 
- Exact numeric thresholds for safety hits for each product line (hosted vs dedicated may differ).
- How to represent entropy budget in console UI so teams can reason about slice fragility.
- Policy for customer-facing rollbacks in private deployments (air-gapped approval flows may be slower).

Mini checklist to ship a first pilot (MVP):
- [ ] Console shortcut for routing flip exists and is tested in staging.
- [ ] Pre-warmed fallback routes + model artifact.
- [ ] Synthetic probe harness integrated with telemetry (15 min cadence).
- [ ] Steward Beacon rotation defined and PD schedule updated.
- [ ] One tabletop run completed with incident postmortem template.

Notes & links for later: 
- See linked Confluence page for contract template and example acceptance tests.
- We should add an internal library of canonical probe prompts per domain (payments, search, support).
- Consider building an "experiment health score" that weights safety more heavily early in exposure.

Quick glossary:
- Steward Beacon: named steward + one-click escalation path
- Rapid-Rewind: instant routing flip within rewind window
- Entropy Budget: slice fragility score
- Canary Cell: tiny initial traffic cohort

Next immediate steps (owners):
- Maya: carve out acceptance test list and wire up smoke CLI (ETA 2w)
- Ethan: prototype console shortcut for routing flip in staging (ETA 1w)
- Priya: assemble probe prompt list for payments/retrieval (ETA 3w)

End of notes.
